text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
H-Hayahide-san, Ikuno-san!
Sorry to keep you waiting...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That book is...! The culmination of our hard work
has finally taken shape!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The book painstakingly selected after much agonizing
to recommend to someone who doesn't normally read...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes...! An Autumn Reading Week initiative for people who don't like reading—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The free magazine, "Fun Books Recommended by Bookworms♪", is finally finished...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The fact that this became a finished book is all thanks to your help...!
As a library committee member, I truly, truly thank you from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's check what's inside right away.
First, starting with Hayahide-san's assigned pages...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The theme I chose is "Trends."
It's an introduction to books that today's students would want to read.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: After all, these books are filled with the cutting-edge racing theories that were just presented at academic conferences!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ooh. So by reading the featured books, you can get a quick look at theories before they become popular!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure we can catch the interest of
trend-conscious, modern folks as well...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm up next. This time, I took the liberty
of choosing "Dreams" as the theme...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Management techniques to serve as guideposts toward “dreams.”
I wrote a column introducing several books
that help readers acquire those skills.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see! The lineup is mostly business books, but with explanations on how students can interpret them.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's a great corner to support
plans toward one's “dream”...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... Well, I took a bit of a leap
and went with "comedy" as my theme...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Titled: "Companion Books to Enhance
Your Enjoyment of the Classic Don Quixote"...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ho... by unraveling the 17th-century historical context of its debut while adding modern interpretations, you aim to highlight its uniqueness.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If you read the books introduced here and then delve into Don Quixote,
you're sure to burst out laughing...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! Just thinking about how this free magazine might expand our reading circle... gets me so excited...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The free magazine was a huge hit, and Reading Week was an immense success... among fellow bookworms.
